verdict.rationale: cubic's CLI documents connecting an existing ChatGPT Plus/Pro or Claude Code subscription to use those models. That is a first-party bring-your-own-subscription sign-in, but it covers only local reviews, not cubic's agent features broadly. The evidence is a single documentation line. missing for 10: sign-in/auth flow details, coverage beyond local CLI reviews (e.g. PR reviews or fixes), limits/quota behavior under the connected plan, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with my existing product subscription plan to use the coding agent

citations.quote: Connect your existing **ChatGPT Plus/Pro** or **Claude Code** subscription to use its models for local reviews.
The **cubic CLI** reviews local changes before you push.
